MESSAGE FROM DANA:
I'm planning a long day of screen work. How should I set it up?

response.text: To set up for a long day, position your monitor at eye level and about an arm's length away to reduce strain. Use a supportive chair with lumbar support, and remember to follow the 20-20-20 rule: every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds. Finally, make sure your lighting is soft to avoid glare on the screen.
